title: Single-cell mapping of lineage and identity via CellTagging
author: Brent A. Biddy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yxifxke
materials: Day 2 Transduce cells with the CellTag viral library overnight. We transduce cells with fresh viral supernatant, with the addition of protamine sulfate. Polybrene can also be used to enhance transduction efficiency. Protamine Sulfate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P3369-10G We transduce MEFs at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of around 3-4. This results in each cell expressing a unique combination of CellTags, increasing the confidence of downstream clone calling. We do not track cells expressing fewer than 2 CellTags. With an MOI of ~3, we find that around 70% of MEFs express 2 or more CellTags. We use fresh viral supernatant for this step. For some cell types, the media is not compatible, or the cells are sensitive to supernatant. In these cases, we recommend concentration of CellTag viral particles via ultracentrifugation, followed by resuspension in fresh media. In our experience, MEFs, 293Ts, and B-cells respond well to viral transduction with supernatant. Difficult to transduce cells may also benefit from viral concentration and spinfection.

steps.title: Amplify Pooled CellTag DNA
steps.instruction: Amplify the pooled CellTag library (V1, V2, or V3) using liquid culture to maintain library complexity.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Stellar Competent Cells (Takara Bio Inc. #636763) in an ice bath.
Mix 100 µL of cells with 10-50 ng of pooled CellTag DNA in a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate the transformation mixture on ice for 30 minutes.
Heat shock the cells at 42 °C for 60 seconds.
Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.
Add SOC medium to reach a final volume of 1000 µL.
Incubate by shaking (~250 rpm) for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Determine Colony Forming Units (CFUs)
steps.instruction: Calculate CFUs to ensure library complexity, aiming for 100-200 CFUs per unique CellTag.

substeps.instruction: Take 5 µL of the recovery culture and prepare serial dilutions from 1:10 to 1:1000.
Plate dilutions onto LB + Ampicillin plates and spread evenly.
Grow overnight at 37 °C.
Count colonies to calculate CFUs based on library size (V1: 19,973; V2: 4,934; V3: 5,737 unique CellTags).

steps.title: Purify CellTag Library
steps.instruction: Scale up the culture and purify the plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add the remaining recovery culture to 500 mL of LB + Ampicillin.
Grow overnight while shaking (~250 rpm) at 37 °C.
Harvest cells and purify the library using Qiagen Megaprep columns (QIAGEN Plasmid Plus Mega Kit #12981) or multiple Maxiprep columns.

steps.title: Generate CellTag Whitelist via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the CellTag region to create a whitelist for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a PCR reaction with: 25 µL 2x Kapa HiFi Hotstart Readymix (#KK2602), 1.5 µL 10 uM forward primer, 1.5 µL 10 uM reverse primer, and 20 ng of CellTag plasmid library.
Run the PCR program: 95 °C for 3 min; 12 cycles of (98 °C for 20s, 65 °C for 15s, 72 °C for 20s); then 72 °C for 1 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify and Quality Control PCR Library
steps.instruction: Purify the tagmented library and verify size via Tapestation.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL of room temperature AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter #A63880) to the PCR tube (0.6x ratio).
Purify per manufacturer's instructions and elute in 10 µL H2O.
Run a Tapestation High Sensitivity d5000 tape (Agilent #5067-5592/5067-5593) using 1 µL of purified cDNA as input.

steps.title: Sequence and Analyze Whitelist
steps.instruction: Sequence the library to identify existing CellTags.

substeps.instruction: Sequence on Illumina MiSeq according to manufacturer's instructions.
Perform sequence analysis using the provided GitHub code/tutorials to generate the whitelist.
Day 1: Change media approximately two hours prior to transfection.
Day 0: Plate cells on a 10cm plate at 50-60% confluency.

steps.title: Transfect 293T Cells for Virus Production
steps.instruction: Transfect cells with CellTag plasmid and packaging plasmids using X-tremeGENE9.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Tube 1: 200 µL DMEM + 15 µL X-tremeGENE9 (#6365779001).
Prepare Tube 2: 200 µL DMEM + 2 µg CellTag plasmid + 200 ng pCMV-VSV-G (#8454) + 2 µg pCMV-dR8.2 dvpr (#8455).
Transfer DMEM+DNA (Tube 2) to DMEM+X-tremeGENE9 (Tube 1), mix by pipetting, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add the mix dropwise to the cell culture plate and distribute evenly by gently pushing the plate.

steps.title: Harvest and Titrate Virus
steps.instruction: Collect viral supernatant and determine the titre.

substeps.instruction: Day 3: Collect cell supernatant, filter through a 0.45 µM low-protein-binding syringe filter, and add fresh media to cells.
Day 4: Collect cell supernatant, filter through a 0.45 µM low-protein-binding syringe filter, and discard cells.
Titre the virus using fluorescence titering, flow cytometry, or the provided imaging-based software.

steps.title: Transduce Target Cells (e.g., MEFs)
steps.instruction: Transduce target cells with the CellTag virus library.

substeps.instruction: Day 1: Plate MEFs at 50,000 cells per well in a 6-well plate on 0.1% gelatin.
Day 3: Change media; verify GFP expression.
Culture for an additional 48 hours until most cells are GFP positive.

steps.title: Sample Harvest and Clonal Expansion
steps.instruction: Periodically harvest cells for scRNA-seq and replate for expansion.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells in calcium- and magnesium-free PBS.
Dissociate gently using TrypLE Express (#12604013).
Wash in DMEM + 10% FBS.
Methanol fix a minimum of 10,000 cells (ideally 25,000 for 10x Genomics or 100,000 for Drop-seq).
Replate remaining cells for continued clonal expansion.

steps.title: Perform Multi-round CellTagging
steps.instruction: Apply subsequent libraries (V2, V3) to support lineage reconstruction.

substeps.instruction: For MEFs, transduce with V2 library 5 days after V1 tagging.
Transduce with V3 library 15 days after V1 tagging.

steps.title: Single-Cell Capture and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Process harvested cells using standard scRNA-seq workflows.

substeps.instruction: Process cells via 10x Genomics or Drop-seq platforms according to standard protocols.
Rehydrate fixed cells according to 10x Genomics instructions.
Sequence to a depth of at least 30,000 reads per cell.
